title: A minimum-norm solution
promptMarkdown: In real $\ell^2$ minimise $\|x\|_2$ subject to $\sum_{n\ge1}2^{-n}x_n=1$. Prove existence, uniqueness, and the exact minimum without a finite-dimensional truncation argument.
hintLadder: Regard the constraint as an inner product with one vector.
Find when Cauchy–Schwarz is sharp, then use an orthogonal decomposition.

criteria.criterion: Justifies convergence and boundedness of the constraint.
